Hurried cycle a few notes for new travelers
Please read this before you travel

Travel notice for companion animals

Travelers need to check pet documents, carrier fit, and airport screening before arrival. Keep all animals secure, calm, and ready for inspection so service can move without delay.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways manages support from booking through pickup, and the senior coordinator makes daily service calls. <<FACT F017>> Follow staff directions closely, because safety comes before speed on every trip. If your journey involves more than one stop, confirm each handoff before you leave home.

<<FACT F010>> and every traveler must still follow the same screening rules. <<FACT F021>> Bring all required papers, arrive prepared, and keep your pet with you until staff guide the next step.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at once for final checks before departure.
